paraphrase: A creature that reaches zero hit points must make death saving throws.
When your hit points drop to 0 you roll saving throws against dying.
A long rest lasts at least eight hours and restores your hit points.
After sleeping for eight hours or more you get all your hit points back.
The Dodge action makes attack rolls against you harder until your next turn.
If you dodge, enemies have a worse chance to hit you until the start of your next turn.
Hiding requires a Dexterity check while you are out of sight of enemies.
To hide you must succeed on a Stealth roll and no enemy may see you.
A grappled creature has a Speed of zero.
While you are grappled you cannot move at all.
Plate armor is the heaviest armor and costs 1,500 gold pieces.
The most protective armor, plate, is priced at fifteen hundred gold.
A rogue deals extra damage once per turn when the attack has advantage.
Sneak attack adds bonus damage a single time each turn if you have advantage.
Fireball explodes in a sphere and deals fire damage to everything inside.
The fireball spell blasts a spherical area, burning each creature in it.
Casting a spell that needs concentration ends your previous concentration spell.
You can hold only one concentration spell, so starting another stops the first.
A prone creature has disadvantage on its attack rolls.
Lying on the ground makes your own attacks harder to land.
Exhaustion lowers the d20 rolls of a creature for each level it has.
Every level of exhaustion subtracts from the creature's d20 tests.
The Help action lets you aid an ally's ability check.
You can assist a friend on a skill check by taking the help action.
A shield adds two to your armor class while you hold it.
Carrying a shield raises your AC by 2.
Bonus actions are limited to one per turn.
You may take only a single bonus action on your turn.
Difficult terrain costs extra movement to cross.
Moving through rough ground uses up more of your speed.
A creature that is stable does not need to make death saving throws.
Once you are stabilised you stop rolling against death.
